title: Project Overview
description: Start with the main SKILL.md to understand the 7-phase pipeline that analyzes codebases and produces interactive knowledge graphs.

title: Project Scanning
description: The scan-project.mjs script discovers all project files, detects languages and frameworks, and builds an import map — the foundation of all subsequent analysis.

title: Semantic Batching
description: The compute-batches.mjs script groups files into semantic batches using Louvain community detection on the import graph, so related files are analyzed together.

title: Import Map Extraction
description: The extract-import-map.mjs script resolves imports across multiple languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go) to build a complete dependency graph.

title: Structure Extraction
description: The extract-structure.mjs script uses TreeSitter to extract function and class definitions from source files, enabling detailed code-level nodes.

title: Graph Merging
description: The merge-batch-graphs.py script combines per-batch graph files into a single assembled graph, normalizing node IDs, deduplicating, and linking test coverage.

title: Domain & Knowledge Sub-skills
description: Specialized skills for extracting domain context and processing wiki-style knowledge bases into graph nodes.

title: User-Facing Skills
description: Skills that provide the interactive interfaces to the knowledge graph: chat-based querying, visual dashboard, diff analysis, explain, and onboarding.

title: Language & Framework References
description: Reference documents that guide how different programming languages and frameworks are analyzed, providing language-specific edge patterns and naming conventions.

title: Localization & Configuration
description: Locale guidance for multi-language output and configuration files that control analysis behavior.
